title: Free Ride
items: Free Ride boots straight into Freestyle with unlimited time on Stadium: Main Event, movies skipped.
Optionally choose the rider and ATV on the way in.

title: Start page
items: A start page with Play and Free Ride, settings (display, movies, volume, controls, settings as text), saves, game data and this page.
In-game menu on F1 or Esc: FPS counter, fullscreen, screenshot, settings, download log, quit.
Keyboard and gamepad controls can be rebound.

title: Your own game folder
items: The page asks for the folder of your own ATV Quad Power Racing 2 (USA) copy, checks default.xbe, and copies the files into this browser's storage once (about 0.7 GB; less without the movies).
An interrupted import resumes; "Forget game files" removes the copy and keeps the saves.
The local server sends no game data at all.

title: A race at 60 fps in Edge
items: Races run at a steady 60 fps (uncapped about 116): the game thread no longer spins in D3D's kick-off, and the page draws straight from shared memory.
Keyboard and gamepad drive player 1; the controller no longer gives up when it starts late.

title: Sound and movie skip
items: Sound plays in the browser through an AudioWorklet after the first click or key.
Skip the movies to reach PRESS START in under 15 seconds.

title: WebGPU
items: The game's GPU work is recorded as frame packets and drawn with WebGPU: NV2A vertex programs and register combiners become WGSL shaders.
Guest memory and the hardware registers work without page faults, as WebAssembly needs.

title: GPU renderer
items: First GPU-drawn frames, then vertex programs and combiners on the GPU, then a full race at full speed.
Mipmaps, tyres and the black-square bug fixed.

title: Static recompile
items: The retail Xbox game translated to C with xboxrecomp and running on Windows: menus, races, movies.
